name: Flow2GAN (Hybrid Flow Matching + GAN, Multi-Resolution Network)
capability_it_enables: High-fidelity audio generation/vocoding from Mel-spectrograms or discrete audio tokens with few-step (even one-step) inference, combining flow matching and GAN training.
verbatim_quote: Flow2GAN enables high-fidelity audio generation from Mel-spectrograms or discrete audio tokens with efficient few-step (even one-step) inference.

name: SGNO: Spectral Generator Neural Operator
capability_it_enables: Stable long-horizon autoregressive PDE rollouts via a residual time-stepper using exponential time differencing in Fourier space with a learned diagonal generator; lower long-horizon error than baselines on 1D/2D/3D PDE families.
verbatim_quote: SGNO maps the current state and coordinates to the next state through a residual neural operator.

name: Lance (3B native unified multimodal model for image+video generation/editing)
capability_it_enables: Single 3B model that performs image and video understanding, generation, and editing including image-to-video (i2v) within one framework; weights released on HuggingFace.
verbatim_quote: Lance is a 3B native unified multimodal model that supports image and video understanding, generation, and editing within a single framework.

name: Bernini (MLLM semantic planner + DiT renderer for video generation/editing)
capability_it_enables: Unified video generation and editing that combines an MLLM-based semantic planner with a DiT-based renderer; inference code and model weights (Bernini-R) released.
verbatim_quote: Bernini is a unified framework for video generation and editing that combines an MLLM-based semantic planner with a DiT-based renderer.

name: MeanVoiceFlow (One-step Nonparallel Voice Conversion with Mean Flows)
capability_it_enables: One-step nonparallel voice conversion trained from scratch (no distillation), using average-velocity mean flows to compute the time integral along the inference path in a single step.
verbatim_quote: mean flows employ average velocity to compute the time integral along the inference path in a single step

name: FLAC: Few-shot Acoustic Synthesis with Multimodal Flow Matching
subfield: Generative models beyond images (scientific/acoustic data - room impulse responses)
capability_it_enables: Few-shot generation of room impulse responses (RIRs) at arbitrary positions in novel scenes using a DiT trained with a flow-matching objective, conditioned on spatial/geometric/acoustic cues; one-shot beats SOTA eight-shot baselines.
verbatim_quote: FLAC leverages a diffusion transformer trained with a flow-matching objective to generate RIRs at arbitrary positions in novel scenes, conditioned on spatial, geometric, and acoustic cues.

name: UNISON: Unified Sound Generation and Editing via Deep LLM Fusion
capability_it_enables: Single latent-diffusion model with shared weights handling text-to-audio, text-to-speech, zero-shot speaker cloning, mixed speech-and-sound generation, and scene-level audio editing via layer-wise deep LLM fusion (~4x smaller than comparable unified systems).
verbatim_quote: A single model handles text-to-audio, text-to-speech, zero-shot speaker cloning, mixed speech-and-sound generation, scene-level audio editing, speech-in-scene editing, and timed temporal composition, all of which share a single set of weights.

name: OGPP: Orbit-Space Particle Flow Matching (Orbit-Space Geometric Probability Paths)
subfield: Generative models beyond images (3D / scientific particle systems)
capability_it_enables: Particle-native flow-matching for generative modeling of particle/point systems using orbit-space canonicalization and geometric probability paths; reduces metric error by up to two orders of magnitude in a single inference step on minimal-surface benchmarks and matches SOTA with 5x fewer steps on ShapeNet.
verbatim_quote: particles live in physical space, so the flow terminal velocity has physical meaning and can encode geometric attributes, e.g., surface normals.

name: Cellular Sheaf Neural Operators for Structure-Preserving PDE Surrogates
subfield: Scientific ML / neural operators (constrained PDEs, MHD/fusion)
capability_it_enables: Discretization-aware, structure-preserving neural PDE surrogate that represents states on oriented cell complexes and uses incidence/Hodge-informed message passing; improves divergence control, spectral error, and equilibrium regression on turbulent MHD and fusion-equilibrium tasks.
verbatim_quote: On turbulent MHD and fusion-equilibrium surrogate tasks, the method improves structure-sensitive diagnostics, including rollout behavior, divergence control, spectral error, and equilibrium-regression accuracy.

name: Langevin Speculative Dynamics (LSD) - Speculative Sampling for Faster Molecular Dynamics
capability_it_enables: Distributed, model-agnostic speculative sampler that accelerates molecular dynamics without adding relative error by using a fast draft model proposing steps verified in parallel by a slower target model; error-free speedups of up to 9x.
verbatim_quote: LSD uses a draft model to propose fast simulation steps and verifies them in parallel with a slower target model, applying a transport map from the draft to the target distribution.

name: GIST: Gauge-Invariant Spectral Transformers for Scalable Graph Neural Operators
subfield: Scientific ML / neural operators (graph/mesh PDE surrogates)
capability_it_enables: O(N)-complexity, gauge-invariant spectral positional encodings for graph/mesh neural operators that avoid cubic eigendecomposition while preserving gauge symmetry, improving inductive generalization on meshes.
verbatim_quote: GIST (Gauge-Invariant Spectral Transformer) is a graph transformer that resolves the tension between exact spectral methods and efficient approximations by restricting attention to pairwise inner products of efficient approximate spectral embeddings.

name: SCNO: Spiking Compositional Neural Operator (Neuromorphic Foundation Model for Nuclear PDEs)
subfield: Scientific ML / neural operators (compositional PDE solving)
capability_it_enables: Modular spiking neural operator that keeps a library of small blocks each trained on a single elementary differential operator (convection, diffusion, reaction) and composes them via an input-conditioned aggregator to solve coupled PDEs unseen during training, with ~95K parameters.
verbatim_quote: SCNO with correction achieves the lowest relative L2 error on four of five coupled PDEs, outperforming both a monolithic spiking DeepONet (by up to 62%) and a standard ANN DeepONet (by up to 65%), while requiring only 95K trainable parameters versus 462K for the monolithic baseline.
